verdict.rationale: Databricks documents Structured Streaming as a first-class API for expressing streaming computation like batch, with Delta Lake as both streaming source and sink offering exactly-once guarantees, and end-to-end latency as low as five milliseconds, plus Auto Loader for incremental file ingestion — directly satisfying the 'low-latency queryable streaming writes via documented API' story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmarks confirming real-world 'seconds to queryable' latency claims and a single unified 'streaming ingestion API' reference page rather than several related docs.
